The financial firm has just set a target of $222.0 on Apple (AAPL) shares. This is 31.28 % from the current stock price. In a research report issued to clients on Thursday, 13 December, Piper Jaffray reconfirmed their Overweight rating on shares of AAPL.
The stock increased 1.09% or $1.85 during the last trading session, reaching $170.95. About 31.67M shares traded. Apple Inc. (AAPL) has risen 0.17% since December 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.17% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on February, 7. They expect $4.74 EPS, up 21.85 % or $0.85 from last year’s $3.89 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $22.49B for 9.02 P/E if the $4.74 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.91 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 62.89 % EPS growth.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $811.23 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 14.35 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
